problem: A provider intent can be younger than its route deadline at the initial polling cutoff but older than that deadline immediately before authenticated submission.

active_identity_proof.interpretation: The recovered v51 process loaded the exact immediate pre-submission safeguard and additive timing telemetry from its verified prestart implementation bundle.

current_run_observation.interpretation: Later telemetry crossed the 30-second boundary only for ineligible evaluations. No action was lost or submitted late, while the measured timing confirms that immediate submission-time revalidation is necessary.

validation.deadline_semantics: An entry at the exact ceiling remains executable; an entry above it is withheld once as stale_before_submission.
validation.exit_semantics: Automatic exits bypass the entry-age gate.

limitations: No eligible entry occurred in this recovered run, so the fresh and stale submission branches are not yet forward-observed under this exact process identity.
A pre-submission guard cannot bound venue acknowledgement latency after the authenticated request begins.
Ineligible evaluations beyond the deadline are capacity telemetry, not missed trades or strategy-edge evidence.
falsifier: Reject this acceptance if an entry older than its exact route deadline reaches engine.enter, an exit is delayed by entry freshness logic, active implementation hashes diverge from the recorded prestart manifest, or routing and withheld telemetry fail to reconcile.
